description: Replace the list of recurring weekly commitments. days are ISO weekdays 1=Mon..7=Sun; use timesPerWeek instead when there are no fixed days. Pass existing ids to keep them.

assumed.description: true when the number is your inference, not something the user stated

insideWindowId.description: id of a kind:window entry this commitment is carved out of, so the window is not counted twice

kind.description: commitment = unavailable and belongs to an area; overhead = unavailable and belongs to no area (sleep, meals, hygiene, moving between places); window = time available for focus work. Default commitment.

usableForWork.description: committed but still workable (waiting, being a passenger)

name: set_commitments
title: Set commitments
